youtube_title: 4 Colour = 4 Screen — Flatbed Screen Print में Setup Cost क्यों बढ़ती है
instagram_title: 4 Colour Flatbed Screen Print — Why Each Colour Needs Its Own Screen
youtube_description:
Why does every extra colour in flatbed screen printing add development time and cost? The design is first separated into its individual colours, each screen prints only one colour, so a 4-colour design needs 4 separate screens. Out-of-registration (pattern out of fit) is a common defect, and printing defects can't be repaired. If you need many colours, compare a digital inkjet quote too — inkjet printing needs no screens. (Source: CottonWorks guide to cotton printing types.)
